title: Choose Khepri's Egyptian design world
question: Which ancient-Egyptian visual language makes Khepri feel distinctive, credible, and built around provable retail decisions?

options.label: Temple Axis
options.lineage: temple axes, carved registers, and monumental Egyptian proportion
options.thesis: Khepri presents every decision on a monumental axis: admitted facts endure, while unsupported claims stop at a visible threshold.
options.viewport: A bilingual claim anchors a monumental stone grid while one synthetic export passes through carved registers for proven and withheld results.
options.risk: Monumentality can feel institutional unless the retail evidence stays immediate and legible.

raised.raise: The same specimen repeats across proven, caveated, and withheld print states.
Every claim has a visible seam back to its evidence.
Admission follows one deterministic motion path and settles without bounce.
State is always printed as text and the experience remains keyboard-complete.

options.label: The Scribe's Ledger
options.lineage: papyrus account rolls, reed-pen grids, and administrative seals
options.thesis: Khepri is a contemporary scribe: every answer is entered with its source, and unsupported lines remain visibly unrecorded.
options.viewport: A modern bilingual papyrus ledger records one synthetic sales file, its admitted facts, and an explicitly withheld comparison.
options.risk: Papyrus can become nostalgic or ornamental if the information design is not sharply contemporary.

options.label: The Nile Market
options.lineage: Nile trade routes, market tallies, and night-market wayfinding
options.thesis: A Nile-blue route carries one retail export toward the answers that can safely enter the market record.
options.viewport: A Nile-blue signal path links the source file to proven market tallies while one ochre route ends in a named refusal.
options.case: The strongest retail energy and motion, balanced by ancient Egyptian trade cues.
options.risk: It can feel artisanal unless the evidence specimen remains dominant and exact.

options.label: The Excavated Ledger
options.lineage: archaeological strata, Egyptian administrative records, and scarab seals
options.thesis: Khepri excavates only what the source can support; each admitted fact appears as a recoverable layer and every refusal remains in situ.
options.viewport: A monumental basalt field reveals a stratified papyrus evidence slab, with proven results intact and an unsupported comparison visibly interrupted.
options.case: The most distinctive fusion of ancient Egypt, provenance, and modern evidence behavior.
options.risk: Heavy archaeological texture must be restrained in implementation to protect performance and legibility.

options.label: Editioned Evidence
options.thesis: One retail fact repeats until its supported and unsupported states become visible differences.
options.viewport: Repeated specimen frames expose state differences through registration rather than decoration.
options.case: The edition metaphor is visually forceful but does not identify the audience or the product clearly enough.
options.kept: Repeat the same specimen across all three trust states instead of explaining them abstractly.
options.risk: Misregistration can imply error where Khepri needs deterministic precision.

options.label: The Provenance Seam
options.lineage: memory quilts and stitched cloth labels
options.thesis: Each answer is a block whose visible seam leads back to its source and date.
options.viewport: Unequal evidence blocks join into one analysis while every seam remains traceable.
options.case: Excellent provenance behavior, but domestic memory does not identify a mixed enterprise retail audience.
options.kept: Make the evidence connection physically visible beside every claim.
options.risk: Soft material cues can weaken the sense of governed, repeatable calculation.

options.label: The Admission Field
options.lineage: gravity-rain gardens and deterministic vector fields
options.thesis: Every input follows a visible law toward a supported answer or a named stop.
options.viewport: Rows flow through one visible field and settle into claims, caveats, or refusals.
options.case: The deterministic path is true, but the surreal garden obscures retail context and product clarity.
options.kept: Use one purposeful, deterministic motion path for admission and state changes.
options.risk: Simulation spectacle would compete with comprehension and no-JavaScript resilience.

options.label: The Night Ledger
options.lineage: ANSI bulletin boards and character-grid interfaces
options.thesis: The entire claim is built from text cells, so state can never hide behind decoration.
options.viewport: A bilingual 80-column result screen streams one export into explicit textual outcomes.
options.case: Strong technical honesty, but it speaks primarily to engineers and risks retro-terminal novelty.
options.kept: Keep every state textual and every interaction keyboard-operable.
options.risk: The terminal world narrows the audience and undermines premium marketing breadth.

canonCard.label: Egyptian Modernist
canonCard.thesis: A safer enterprise page using Egyptian color and geometry as a restrained brand layer over a conventional product layout.
canonCard.viewport: A concise bilingual headline sits beside a clean evidence specimen with restrained Egyptian framing and familiar enterprise navigation.
canonCard.risk: Clear and credible, but less ownable and emotionally transporting than the artifact-led directions.
